name: Commands run, refused and contained as scripted
purpose: An arm runs the commands that must run, refuses the ones that must never run unattended, contains a write outside its folder (also by a program that opens the path itself) and keeps a scratch folder for the whole session.
record: The share of eleven scripted cases (evaluation/command_execution/build_cases.py) whose conditions all hold: one-line and several-line commands, a write in the folder, a bounded output, a timeout that ends the group, three commands the floor must refuse, two writes outside the folder (a redirect and a program) that must not land, and a scratch file read by the next command. No model call.
disadvantages: Written cases, not a real run; no network, memory or process-limit cases; the disk stays readable in the wrapper, so reading a secret is not measured; Linux only.
command: esoi run command_execution --impl refusal_floor; esoi run command_execution --impl bubblewrap_wrapper
